design.effect: r^2 = beta^2 V / (beta^2 V + sigma2), V = Var(s - E[s|C-1]); Var(T) = 1

engines.F1: RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, min_samples_leaf=max(5, ceil(.005 n_train)), max_features=.5, n_jobs=1)
engines.F2: GradientBoostingRegressor(max_depth=2, learning_rate=.05, subsample=.8, n_estimators=1000, n_iter_no_change=20, validation_fraction=.2)
engines.F3: LGBMRegressor(num_leaves=15, learning_rate=.05, min_child_samples=max(20, ceil(.01 n_train)), subsample=.8, subsample_freq=1, reg_lambda=1, n_estimators=1000, num_threads=1, deterministic=True, force_col_wise=True); early stopping patience 50 on an inner 20% split

test_details.gcm: R = eT*eX over all rows; Z = sqrt(n) mean/sd, two-sided normal (g0/g1); CR1 fold-cluster t(K-1) (g2)
test_details.pcm: per half h: g on A (all candidates), m = E[g|C-j] on A, hB = g(B) - m(B); cross-fitted (K folds within B) GCM of T vs hB given C-j, one-sided; p = min(1, 2 min(pA, pB))
test_details.clarification: PCM's second-half regressions are cross-fitted within the half (protocol 2.3 step 2), so flexible engines are never evaluated in-sample

generation_order: V = rng.standard_normal((n, p)) @ cholesky(Sigma).T  (latent candidates X1, X0, Z1, Z2, M[, W1..W5])
u = rng.standard_normal(n)  (measurement error; always drawn, used only in shape E)
X = V, except shape E: X1 = sqrt(.8) V1 + sqrt(.2) u
s = shape(V1, M); heteroskedastic null: eps *= sqrt((1 + Z2^2 + X0^2) / 3)
fold5[perm] = arange(n) % 5 with perm = rng.permutation(n); then fold10 likewise (% 10); then half[perm] = arange(n) % 2

criteria.c1_se: binomial SE at the tested rate (.055 limit; .06 gross)
criteria.c2: power >= 0.9 power(R1) - z99 SE_paired at N = 5,000, shape L
